ok.meaning: Whether the lock-in table was read successfully.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: First blocking outcome; none means no missing signal.

drives.meaning: Rows of drives locked in to this house.

part_uuid.meaning: GPT PARTUUID of the role-labelled NAS partition.

holder.meaning: this for this HomeServer, otherwise the holder box's lower-case MAC.

locked_in_at.meaning: UTC time when the row was locked in.
